title: Japanese Smoked Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with smoked beef, inspired by Japanese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the smoked beef and stir-fry until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and stir-fry until they are tender-crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir-fry for an additional 1 minute.
Serve the beef and vegetables hot, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions if desired.
